{{Quote|You're interested in them as much as I am! How exciting! After I gather my supplies, I'm headed to the Gungan Stronghold, however. I have some deals to conduct with my allies there. The Gungans are really friendly when you get to know them. I'll be off to my studies after that. It's the veermok's feeding time.|Ronin Lightrunner, to a spacer|<ref name="SWG:RL" />}}
'''Ronin Lightrunner''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Mon Calamari/Legends|Mon Calamari]] [[Biologist/Legends|biologist]] who lived on [[Naboo/Legends|Naboo]] during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]]. After the [[Battle of Yavin/Legends|Battle of Yavin]], he worked at the [[Moenia University]], in the city of [[Moenia/Legends|Moenia]], and studied the [[Veermok/Legends|veermoks]]. Lightrunner was really impassioned by these creatures and excited by his work. For his researches, Ronin Lightrunner used to visit the [[Veermok Cave]] in the [[Gallo Mountains/Legends|Gallo Mountains]] and befriended with the [[Gungan/Legends|Gungans]] of the [[Gungan Warrior Stronghold]].<ref name="SWG:RL" />

==Behind the scenes==
Ronin Lightrunner was a [[Wikipedia:Non-player character|non-player character]] in the [[2003]] [[Star Wars video games|video game]] ''[[Star Wars Galaxies]]'', a [[Wikipedia:Massively multiplayer online role-playing game|massively multiplayer online roleplaying game]] developed by [[Sony]] Online Entertainment and published by [[LucasArts]],<ref name="SWG:RL" /> prior to its closure on [[December 15]], [[2011]].<ref name="Shutdown">{{SonyCite|url=playerinfo|text=IMPORTANT INFORMATION ABOUT ''STAR WARS'' GALAXIES™}}</ref> Ronin Lightrunner was added to the game with the "[[W:c:swg:Publish 5 Notes: 16 December 03|Publish 5]]" update, released on [[December 16]], 2003.<ref name="SonyCite-Publish 5: Vehicles">{{SonyCite|url=recent_updates.jsp?o=60892|text=Publish 5: Vehicles}}</ref>
